title: Logical Organization
description: Essential Criteria: The response follows a clear, traceable structure where each claim flows logically to the next and the overall argument path is easy to follow without re-reading.

title: Claim Support
description: Essential Criteria: Every major claim is accompanied by either evidence, a warrant, or explicit logical reasoning. No bare assertions are left unsupported.

title: Evidence Relevance
description: Important Criteria: Evidence cited is directly relevant to the claim it supports and is not stretched or misapplied to cover a different point.

title: Conduct and Representation
description: Important Criteria: The response accurately represents the opponent's position without distortion, strawmanning, or selective omission of context.

title: Concision
description: Optional Criteria: The response avoids redundancy, filler phrases, and restating already-established points without adding new content.

title: Bare Assertion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Does not make claims of fact or impact without any supporting warrant, evidence, or logical chain.

title: Position Misrepresentation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Does not mischaracterize or exaggerate the opponent's stated position in order to make it easier to refute.
